Personality: Clondicus, a prominent figure of the Peucini, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Clondicus owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Peucini. Historical Record: War-king of the Bastarnae, who looks south for new lands for his people and for a king rich enough to hire them. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
